summary: The registrant, Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund (the Fund), filed an 8-K to report its completion of an acquisition of substantially all assets of affiliate Nuveen Churchill BDC V (BDC V) for $346.95M in cash, equal to BDC V's net asset value as of April 29, 2026. The Fund also assumed $511M in liabilities. The transaction was approved by both boards of trustees and BDC V's shareholders on April 30, 2026. The Fund funded the purchase with borrowings under its credit facilities. The acquirer and target are externally managed by Nuveen-affiliated advisors. Watch for integration effects on the Fund's leverage and portfolio composition.
